subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the light orb to your destination
Find a way to leave the mysterious space

760280301.text: #Waaah, there you are, {NICKNAME}! When those two glowing things crashed into each other, the explosion sent Paimon flying! It's a good thing she didn't get hurt...

760280302.text: It took Paimon forever to fly back here... Paimon's just glad you're okay!

760280304.text: Paimon under— Huh? Wait, what do you mean by flying?

760280305.text: You tell Paimon what you just saw...

760280306.text: #Hmm, Paimon's never heard about a place like that in Teyvat... Are you sure you weren't just seeing things, {NICKNAME}?

760280307.text: Anyway, as long as you're okay, that's all that matters! There's just way too much weird stuff going on around here. Let's leave this place before it's too late...

760280312.text: Ugh, Paimon didn't think they'd be that dangerous, and we didn't even find any treasure in the end... Why would something like that show up here, anyway?

760280313.text: And if those two glowing things weren't Seelies... then what were they?

760280309.text: You tell Paimon what you just saw...

760280310.text: #Hmm, Paimon's never heard about a place like that in Teyvat... Are you sure you weren't just seeing things, {NICKNAME}?
